question: For the closed-FRW V=0 constraint on the p>0 branch, does the explicitly declared positive classical rescaling H=12*pi^2*exp(3Q/2)*C followed by the flat Schrödinger ordering on L2(dQ dphi) admit an exact Kontorovich-Lebedev spectral realization, and what distributional group-averaged physical measure follows for this selected densitized operator?

upstream_results.role: pins Q=2 log(a), the exact classical V=0 constraint, and the p>0 component without importing a quantum ordering
supplies only the previously declared local Mc comparison representation and its dp zero-fiber form, not an equivalence theorem

primary_sources.source: NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions, 10.25.1 and 10.43.30-31
primary_sources.used_for: the modified-Bessel equation and the Kontorovich-Lebedev transform/inverse normalization
primary_sources.not_used_for: choosing the cosmological constraint, densitization, ordering, branch, or physical interpretation

primary_sources.source: Marolf, Refined Algebraic Quantization: Systems with a single constraint, arXiv:gr-qc/9508015
primary_sources.used_for: the single-constraint rigging-map and group-averaging framework
primary_sources.not_used_for: deriving the repository-specific spectral multiplier or measure

primary_sources.source: Giulini, Group Averaging and Refined Algebraic Quantization, arXiv:gr-qc/0003040
primary_sources.used_for: the distributional group-average and quotient/completion boundary
primary_sources.not_used_for: asserting convergence outside the declared spectral test space

primary_sources.source: Louko and Martinez-Pascual, Constraint rescaling in refined algebraic quantisation: momentum constraint, arXiv:1107.1092
primary_sources.used_for: the warning that classically equivalent constraint rescalings need not define equivalent quantum theories
primary_sources.not_used_for: proving equivalence between H, the raw C operator, or the declared Mc representation

declared_model.spectral_test_space: C_c^infinity((0,infinity)_kappa times (0,infinity)_p), hence compactly supported away from both open edges
declared_model.group_average_convention: integral_R dN/(2*pi*hbar) exp(-i*N*H_hat/hbar)=delta(H_hat) on the declared spectral test space

exact_plan: derive the positive classical densitization identity exactly
apply the declared flat Schrödinger ordering and Fourier transform only on the p>0 invariant sector
set z=6*pi^2*exp(Q)/hbar and derive H_p=-2*hbar^2*L+3*p^2 with L=-d_Q^2+z^2
use the modified-Bessel equation to derive L K_{i kappa}(z)=kappa^2 K_{i kappa}(z)
use the normalized Kontorovich-Lebedev transform chi_kappa=sqrt(2*kappa*sinh(pi*kappa))/pi*K_{i kappa} to select a self-adjoint spectral realization
solve the simple positive root 3*p^2-2*hbar^2*kappa^2=0 and apply the one-dimensional delta-function coarea factor
derive the physical measure dp/(2*sqrt(6)*hbar*p), its positive quotient completion, and the p=0 singular-edge exclusion
show that the selected physical space is unitarily reweighted to L2(dp) but is not identical to the prior declared dp fiber normalization
leave the raw C ordering/domain, quantum rescaling equivalence, exact endpoint transform, full BFV measure, and physics claims null

decision_table.condition: the densitization, Bessel eigenvalue, KL normalization, spectral multiplier, positive root and coarea weight all pass under the declared test-space and theorem hypotheses
decision_table.meaning: retain one exactly diagonalized minisuperspace constraint and its selected RAQ physical Hilbert measure; do not identify it with raw C, Mc, a full BFV theory, quantum gravity, or physics

decision_table.condition: any densitization, differential reduction, Bessel eigenvalue, zero root, coarea factor, positivity or witness norm check fails
the result silently identifies dp/(2*sqrt(6)*hbar*p) with dp, includes the singular p=0 edge, or asserts invariance under rescaling C to H
decision_table.meaning: reject the measure/equivalence shortcut while preserving any separately passing algebra

computed_scope: one exact positive classical densitization on the V=0 p>0 component
one flat Schrödinger ordering of the densitized original-coordinate constraint
one KL-Fourier self-adjoint spectral realization and its real multiplier
one distributional full-real-N group average on compact-interior spectral tests
the resulting weighted physical fiber and its explicit unitary reweighting to an abstract L2(dp) space
not_computed: a quantum operator, self-adjoint domain, rigging map or physical measure for the undensitized raw C
unitary equivalence under the field-dependent rescaling from C to H
an exact endpoint transform or identity with the prior declared Mc representation
the p=0 edge, p<0 component, both-branch completion or self-adjoint relational Phi observable
a lapse contour derived from the gravitational path integral, a full BFV trajectory measure, determinants, anomalies or BRST cohomology
inhomogeneous gravitational modes, gravitons, renormalization, semiclassical Einstein dynamics, empirical observables, quantum gravity, physics or TOE
